description: Get the latest trade-derived intelligence for one symbol. Use for the raw signals of one symbol; get_snapshot is cheaper for headline numbers.

symbol.description: Any covered symbol, not only the examples: crypto pair (ETHUSD), US ticker (NVDA) or ISIN; free list via get_data_coverage. Unknown symbols are not charged

window.description: Aggregation window of the live trade buckets: 1m, 5m (default) or 15m

name: get_symbol_intelligence
